deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for Autumn 2027 (Winter/Spring starts need prior contact with the department).
deadline.quote: Start Quarter: Autumn 2027-2028 Application Date: December 1, 2026

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: Do not submit GRE scores; they will not be considered.
gre_general.quote: We ask that you do not submit or reference GRE scores in your application, as they will not be considered.

supervisor.value: No advisor agreement is required up front, but the application asks you to name up to three ME faculty who could be your PhD advisor.
supervisor.quote: List up to three Stanford ME faculty members whose research interests overlap with your research interests and are potential PhD advisors.

funding.value: The School of Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs; incoming ME PhD students are given RA positions based on their application.
funding.quote: Stanford Engineering commits to full funding for all PhDs.

also.quote: For the PhD program, incoming students are awarded RA positions based upon the information provided in their admissions application.

entry_route.value: A BS in engineering, physics or a comparable science is enough.
entry_route.quote: Have earned, or be in the process of earning, a BS degree in engineering, physics, or comparable science program.

notes: Aeronautics & Astronautics is a separate Stanford department with its own PhD; this record covers Mechanical Engineering.
